subject: Preflight POC: credit allowance request for nightly latency sweeps
messages:
From: Liam Hart <liam@opsquad.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Preflight POC credit request for nightly latency sweeps

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — OpsQuad is excited to validate Redwood for a customer-facing inference path. Before we spin up the full dedicated run we'd like to execute a preflight: seven nights of automated latency sweeps to validate p95 and throughput under the model/seq lengths we intend to use. High level: 

- Model: rdx-large-v1 (approx 9B)
- Typical prompt+response avg tokens: 512
- Concurrency: 4 parallel clients, simulated steady state for 2 hours/night
- Goal: verify p95 latency ≤ 250ms and stable throughput at 60 qps nominal
- Expected token consumption: ~2.7M tokens across the week (including retries)

Can Redwood provide a short-term credit allowance and a 7-day trial extension so we can run the sweeps in your hosted environment? We can run the tests in us-west. Attached is a compact test-plan and schedule.

If helpful, we can do a quick 20-minute sync to align on the exact environment and any quotas we should avoid hitting. Appreciate any promotional support you can offer to cover the preflight run.

Best,
Liam Hart
Head of Infrastructure
OpsQuad

Attachments: test-plan-nightly-sweeps.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Liam Hart <liam@opsquad.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Preflight POC credit request for nightly latency sweeps

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the plan. This is exactly the kind of preflight we encourage. A few quick clarifying questions so I can get an internal approval routed: 

- Target p95: you listed ≤250ms; is that for cold-start inclusive of KV warming, or steady-state after warmup?
- Sequence lengths: 512 avg — do you have a 95th token-length we should plan for (e.g., 1024) for buffer sizing?
- Are you testing streaming responses or full-chunk generation?
- Please confirm us-west region only and that no customer PII will be sent during the runs.

If all good, I will loop in our AE and CS lead to propose a promotional credit and trial extension. I can also schedule a short alignment call tomorrow morning if you prefer.

Thanks — I'll be the point here.

Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Preflight POC credit request for nightly latency sweeps

Morning team — looping you both in on OpsQuad's preflight request (Liam Hart, OpsQuad). They want a 7-night nightly sweep in us-west to validate p95 and throughput prior to a larger dedicated run. Test plan and token estimate attached. Key asks below: 

- Promotional credit to cover ~2.7M tokens (we should round up to a safe buffer)
- 7-day trial extension to allow consecutive nightly runs

My proposed tidy offer to OpsQuad: 
- Grant $6,000 promotional credit (approx. equivalent to ~3M tokens under our standard trial rates)
- Extend trial window by 7 days from the activation date
- Conditions: non-production use, test accounts only, results shared back to Redwood for internal perf eval, Redwood reserves right to pause if misuse or spike beyond agreed qps

Marissa — can CS apply the quota bump and track the evaluation artifacts? Karthik — please confirm if the $6k credit is okay from a deal economics perspective or if you want to adjust. If yes, I'll confirm with OpsQuad and request PO/contacts for procurement steps.

Attachments: internal_promo_approval_notes.md (MD stub)

Maya
From: Liam Hart <liam@opsquad.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@opsquad.ai
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 07:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Preflight POC credit request for nightly latency sweeps

Maya — thanks, that looks straightforward and appreciated. Quick answers: 
- p95 target is for steady-state (we will run a 15-minute warmup prior to collection)
- 95th token-length is ~900 tokens (we included some edge cases)
- We'll test non-streaming (full-chunk generation) for these runs
- Confirmed: us-west only; test environment will not contain customer PII

Procurement contact (for PO if needed): procurement@opsquad.ai — feel free to include any small-form paperwork. We're happy to accept a promotional credit first and follow up with PO for tracking. Please send link to claim or a HubSpot/DocuSign if you require signature on the promo terms.

I'll be on the 10:00 call today if you want to align live.

—Liam
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Liam Hart <liam@opsquad.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Preflight POC credit request for nightly latency sweeps

Liam — all set. We've applied a promotional grant and quota uplift: 

- Promo credit applied: $6,000 (internal id: OPQ-2027-011-PROMO)
- Token headroom added: +3,000,000 tokens to OpsQuad trial account
- Trial extended by 7 days from activation (credits activate 2027-01-08 00:00:00 UTC, expiry 2027-01-15 00:00:00 UTC)

Actions: 
- Marissa: please confirm quota adjustment and add tracking ticket in our CS tracker (ref: https://redwood-internal.company/ops/OPQ-2027-011)
- Liam: procurement @opsquad, if you want a short acknowledgement doc please sign the attached promo_grant_terms.pdf and return. Otherwise we'll mark the grant as accepted when your run begins.

Attachments: promo_grant_terms.pdf (PDF), quota_adjustment.csv (CSV)

Thanks — good luck with the sweeps, and please share the perf artifacts once complete; we'll run them through our inference evals team and follow up with any tuning suggestions.

Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
